form.label: AI Compliance & Directory
form.description: User lifecycle, directory posture and compliance-relevant activity across AI providers

search.query: `aigov_audit` | eval lifecycle=case(match(aigov_action,"invite"),"invite", match(aigov_action,"user\.added|user_invite_accepted"),"joined", match(aigov_action,"user_deleted|user\.deleted"),"removed", match(aigov_action,"role"),"role_change", true(),null()) | where isnotnull(lifecycle) | timechart count by lifecycle
`aigov_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:user" | dedup id | stats count by role | sort - count

`aigov_directory` | dedup id sourcetype | eval directory_email=coalesce(email, email_address, aigov_user) | where isnotnull(directory_email) | join type=left directory_email [ search `aigov_audit` aigov_user=* earliest=-30d | stats latest(_time) as last_active by aigov_user | rename aigov_user as directory_email ] | where isnull(last_active) | table directory_email aigov_product role status | head 100

table.title: Shadow Users: Active but Not in Directory

search.query: `aigov_audit` aigov_user=* aigov_provider IN ("anthropic","openai") | stats latest(_time) as last_active count by aigov_user aigov_provider | join type=left aigov_user [ search `aigov_directory` | eval aigov_user=coalesce(email, email_address) | dedup aigov_user | eval in_directory="yes" | fields aigov_user in_directory ] | where isnull(in_directory) | convert ctime(last_active) | sort - count
`aigov_audit` | regex aigov_action="export|retention|policy|dlp|compliance" | table _time aigov_product aigov_action aigov_user aigov_src_ip | sort - _time | head 50
